assertion_audit: Archived relative sup/RMS and total-map norm checks fail when recomputed fields differ from their independently stored receipt metrics by more than 1e-9.
Coordinate equality fails if the reconstructed mesh differs from the input archive; finite quadrature fails on NaN or infinity.

Current-moment reconstruction fails if an altered moment image differs from the archived plasma error by more than 1e-9 of its peak; this protects reconstruction of fixed evidence, not the correctness of the upstream archived current booking.
Class closure fails if a class contribution is dropped or duplicated; its sum alone cannot detect exchanging class labels, so it does not fully protect causal attribution.

X-point nonzero analytic-current assertion fails for an identified saddle cell without a definable centroid; no assertion requires a saddle cell to have been detected, although the saved diverted rows each detect one and weak rows detect zero.
Weak-control assertion fails above 1e-4; audit one-percent perturbation deliberately falsifies the norm equality and records ten refusals, but is not a mutation of the measurement implementation.
Summary completed/count assertion fails on missing completion or fewer than ten rows; it does not independently enforce the exact case/rung census.
assessment: Scientific attribution supported with a reproducibility repair required before implementation-worktree cleanup; upstream booking cause and exact-default gate remain open.

findings.text: [P2] The audit opens row['input_archive'] as an absolute implementation-worktree path emitted by benchmarks/diverted_chord_response_attribution.py:377, while run.sh:5 hardcodes the same worktree; after normal cleanup the committed evidence cannot be audited or rerun from main even though its input archives are versioned there.
